evals.prompt: Draft this week's client update for the Northwind website redesign.
evals.expected_output: Uses get_writing_context with the client audience and the snapshot, leads with the status and why, writes risks as Risk / Impact / Recommendation, keeps internal deliberation out but the honest status in, shows the draft, and warns that a posted update can't be edited before posting.
assertions: Calls get_writing_context with the client audience
Leads with the project's status and the reason
Mentions the content timing risk honestly with a recommendation
Leaves out sentiment readings and internal deliberation
Shows a draft and does not post without approval
Says a posted update can't be edited

evals.prompt: Give me a quick roll-up of all my projects for the leadership meeting.
evals.expected_output: Uses cross-project calls, reports by exception (counts by status, detail only on at-risk and off-track projects), and gives no percent complete.
assertions: Gives detail only on at-risk or off-track projects

evals.prompt: Can you send our weekly status to the Northwind client every Friday?
evals.expected_output: Explains Penroe can't email; offers a recurring recipe that saves a draft for review rather than posting automatically.
assertions: Offers a recurring recipe or schedule that drafts rather than posts on its own
Does not post a status update

should_not_trigger: Move the due date on the staging environment task to Friday.
